messages:
hannah-hr: Quick thread to sort Alex's onboarding logistics — I-9 method, background check status, and hardware timing. Alex starts next Monday.
nina-recruiter: Alex prefers notary because they're traveling this week, so mobile notary is the easiest. They can give availability Fri afternoon.
sam-it: Heads up: hardware lead time is 72 hours for custom configs, 24h for standard image. If Alex needs VPN and corp laptop day 1, we should ship expedited. Confirm address and whether they need a dock.
alex-newhire: Hi all 44b I can do mobile notary Fri after 2pm. Shipping address is 88 Harbor Ln, Unit 2. No dock needed. Also would like VPN on day 1 to access the repo during orientation.
hannah-hr: Thanks. For mobile notary option we require a notarized I-9 attestation plus a photo ID scan beforehand. I'll DM the secure upload link.
bgcheck-bot: Checkr status update: background check submitted (Initiated). Typical turnaround 48-72 hours. Will post updates here.
sam-it: @hannah-hr can you confirm whether we can provision VPN access while BG check is pending? Security policy allows limited internal read access pending clear for 1 week. Full access after BG clear.
hannah-hr: Correct — we can grant onboarding SSO groups with limited scopes. Sam, please add to "onboarding-read" group.
sam-it: Will do. Creating ticket now: IT-T5678. ETA imaging (standard) 24h, expedited 8h. Marking as expedited.
nina-recruiter: I'll remind Alex to bring original docs to the notary and to expect a small fee. We reimburse with expense claim.
alex-newhire: Noted. One Q: benefits enrollment link? I didn't get the BenAdmin email yet.
hannah-hr: BenAdmin email is sent automatically on day 1 but we can pre-send the benefits packet PDF. Attaching: "Benefits_Snapshot.pdf" (link in portal).
sam-it: MFA note: bring personal phone for authenticator app. If using hardware token, let us know and we'll arrange.
hannah-hr: Action items:
- nina-recruiter: confirm notary appointment and expense process (due today)
- alex-newhire: meet notary Fri 2:30pm, upload notarized I-9 + ID scan to portal (due Fri)
- sam-it: IT-T5678 created, expedited imaging + add to onboarding-read SSO group (ETA today)
- hannah-hr: pre-send benefits packet and schedule Day-1 orientation (10:00-12:00 PT)

nina-recruiter: Booked notary for Fri 2:30pm and DM'd Alex confirmation.
bgcheck-bot: Checkr status update: background check (In Progress) 0a.
alex-newhire: Uploaded the ID scan and notarized document to the portal. Thanks everyone.
sam-it: Laptop shipped overnight. Tracking: UPS 1Z999... ETA Sat morning. Move ticket to In Progress.
hannah-hr: Great. We'll keep orientation as planned next Monday and adjust access if BG clears earlier. Closing loop here but ping this thread if anything changes. :thumbsup:
